_note: One source of truth for the New-reel funnel. The studio wizard shows `label` + `hint`; the writer applies `writer` for the chosen type and goal; the planner applies `planner`. Edit here, never in the UI or the agents.

explainer.label: Explainer
explainer.hint: One idea, 3-4 named beats, each becomes a card.
explainer.writer: Hook, then 3-4 named beats in full sentences, each naming the thing that appears on screen; one idea per reel; 30-40 s.
explainer.planner: Change something every 2-3 s; cards per beat; face for the hook and the CTA, graphic_full for the beats.

list.label: List
list.hint: '5 tools that…' Fast, one item per second or two.
list.writer: Hook states the count; every item is named in a short full sentence with a payoff word; no filler between items; 20-35 s.
list.planner: Icon grid or item cards, one change per 0.6-1.5 s; items land on their names; face only for the hook and the CTA.

screen_demo.label: Screen demo
screen_demo.hint: Walk through a tool. Real screens in the windows.
screen_demo.writer: Every beat names what is on screen and what to click; the assets table asks for a screenshot or recording per beat with the exact element to highlight; 35-45 s.
screen_demo.planner: Real screens from assets/ in split_top and graphic_full windows with push-ins on the named element; face for the hook, one opinion line and the CTA.

opinion.label: Opinion
opinion.hint: A take. Mostly your face, big captions, one or two cards.
opinion.writer: Hook is the claim; two or three reasons as spoken sentences; one card for the proof point; 20-30 s.
opinion.planner: face_full most of the time with big captions; one or two graphic_full moments on the proof; scenery still changes every 5-8 s.

story.label: Story / result
story.hint: Before and after, what changed, the number.
story.writer: Open on the result or the number; then the before, the change, the after, in order; end on what it means; 30-45 s.
story.planner: Counter or two-panel compare card on the number; face for the before and the after; graphic_full for the change.

views.label: Views / reach
views.hint: Broad topic, hardest hook, no ask at the end.
views.writer: Hook in the first 8 words with a number or a contradiction; broad audience wording; 20-30 s; the CTA is at most 'follow for more', or nothing.

follows.label: Follows
follows.hint: Series framing, open loop, follow CTA.
follows.writer: Frame it as part of a series ('part 1', 'every week I…'); leave an open loop for the next one; CTA: follow, with the reason.

comments.label: Comments / leads
comments.hint: Comment keyword + a promise, DM funnel.
comments.writer: End with one comment keyword in quotes and the promise of what they get; mention the offer once in the middle; 30-40 s.

clicks.label: Link clicks
clicks.hint: One bio-link CTA, the offer named twice.
clicks.writer: Name the offer once in the hook and once at the end; the CTA says where the link is; 30-40 s.

saves.label: Saves / shares
saves.writer: Checklist or step list the viewer wants to keep; number the steps; slower pace, each step a full sentence; CTA: 'save this'; 35-50 s.
